investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Stonepine Mutual (insurance); Platform: on-premises data center DC-North, server range 10.7.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster stonep-prod (kubeadm); External dependency: email-notifier calls a transactional e-mail relay (smtp.sendwave.io) protected by a circuit breaker; external synthetic probes monitor public dependencies; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
